item.tib: brag btsan dmar po'i thugs sgrub
item.coloph: brag btsan rgyal po'i sgrub pa 'di ni/ sgo yi btsun pa dar ma rgyal mtshan bdag go'i cog ro'i bris lung gi gom chung du yod pas/ sprel lo lug zla'i tshes dgu'i dgung ga phar ngos kyi brag rtsar bsdad tsam skyes phran bzhin bzang gcig gis/ rta sngon po zhig bcibs nas bdag nyid rtsar byung ste/ bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs rang rtags srog gi rnying po phul/ khra tshang dgon nas shes rab 'od zer gyis bskul ba btab nas/ dkar chags yi ger btab pa'o/ de nas rim gyis brgyud nas da lta bdag gi bstan srung shin tu zab bo// a+tha/ brag btsan thugs sgrub gsang ba'o/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
